The '''Kuna constellation''' was a constellation visible from [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]]. [[Kuna's Eye/Legends|Kuna's Eye]], [[Kuna's Tooth system/Legends|Kuna's Tooth system]], [[Kuna's Fist/Legends|Kuna's Fist]], [[Kuna's Horn/Legends|Kuna's Horn]], [[Kuna's Tail system/Legends|Kuna's Tail system]], [[Kuna's Heart]], [[Kuna's Scale]], and [[Kuna's Gullet]] were all part of it.<ref name="gamer9" />
